description: This file implements a vector storage system using SQLite database, providing methods for setting, retrieving, deleting, and searching vector records, specifically tailored for in-memory vector management with persistence.

classes.name: sqliteVectorStore
classes.description: A struct representing a SQLite-backed vector store, managing vector records with operations for storage and retrieval.

methods.name: newSQLiteVectorStore
methods.description: Constructor function that creates a new instance of sqliteVectorStore with a specified database connection and distance metric.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Stores or updates a vector record in the database with associated metadata.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a vector record from the database by scope, scopeID, and key.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific vector record identified by scope, scopeID, and key.

methods.name: DeleteByPrefix
methods.description: Deletes all vector records with keys matching the given prefix, returning the number of rows affected.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Performs a nearest neighbor search for vectors similar to the query embedding within a specific scope and scopeID, applying optional filters.
